package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	redis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
)

type scenario426Report struct {
	ID      int      `json:"id"`
	Title   string   `json:"title"`
	Tags    []string `json:"tags"`
	Content string   `json:"content"`
}

// scenario for redis_large_value_without_compression: `rdb.Set(ctx, key, largePayload, ...)` where `largePayload` is the result of `json.Marshal` on a large struct or slice, without visible compression
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: info.
func scenario426Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	large := make([]scenario426Report, 50000)
	for i := range large {
		large[i] = scenario426Report{
			ID:    i,
			Title: "Report entry with detailed metadata and extensive textual content payload",
			Tags:  []string{"analytics", "monthly", "summary", "detailed"},
		}
	}
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(large)

	rdb := redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{Addr: "localhost:6379"})
	defer rdb.Close()

	if err := rdb.Set(r.Context(), "report:cache", payload, 0).Err(); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
